name: (none)
role: Not yet given a real state - `class_counter` (`+0x2E`) only increments "for every unit whose state is not 0" (see the unit record), consistent with 0 meaning "just allocated, not yet dispatched" rather than an ordinary idle state.

name: idle hand-off
role: Initial state for a person with no active behaviour yet; on an RNG-timed expiry hands off to its own per-type ongoing default via table 0x5A7064 (wildman -> 8, angel -> 28, everyone else -> 10). See "Idle behaviour: the idle hand-off: state 1, then state 10".

name: drowning
role: Entered from the universal life-step when the fine-grained per-pixel drowning check (0x4EEFF0) is true; the state's own per-turn body has not been independently traced (only the entry predicate). See "Drowning".

name: death
role: Universal death for any class-1 person, not preach-specific; reached only from the life-step at life<=0. Pushes the dying person onto the universal spirit-rise handoff slot (0x892443), spawns a class-7 death-puff effect and a class-10 spirit-rise controller. See "Death and the spirit rise".

name: idle near a reference unit
role: Generic "idle-fidget beside a paired unit" (own `+0x72` reference, latched from the setter). Reused by at least two unreconciled subsystems: wildmen idling beside a found tree/plant or "noticed" unit (0x4D48E0/0x4D66E0 set the pairing, longer-lived), and the player-issued preach order (0x43C7A0), which sets its target to this SAME state with a short, fixed `+0x70` timer (0x28, 40 ticks/3.3s, armed once, no re-arm found anywhere in this handler) and also stamps `target+0xA7 = 0x28` (the generic, still not fully pinned "busy" field) at the moment of entry. Every tick while the reference is live and within 120 units on both axes: faces it (every 8th tick) and rolls an idle-fidget-animation-variant via the per-type odds table 0x5A7067 (see 0x5A7064's own row); if the reference goes too far away this tick just no-ops (no revert); timer expiry or a dead/invalid reference falls back unconditionally to the per-type default (table 0x5A7064, shaman special-cased to 0x27) - never writes the person's own state onward itself otherwise. **Re-read this session chasing "Preacher conversion"'s kind-33/state-23 reconciliation: confirmed exhaustively this state never transitions to 23 or connects to `preacher_strike_scan` in any way - the two "preacher" mechanisms are genuinely independent, not a tracing gap. The actual link between a manual preach order and a real conversion is elsewhere (the preacher's own concurrent auto-scan pre-empting its own order) - see pop3-rev-analysis.md "Preacher conversion".**

name: walking to the shore
role: Wildman-only: walks toward a shore-shaped cell found by the state-8 fallback search (0x4D4A00); 0x4D66E0 runs every turn en route to "notice" a nearby scenery head, a vehicle, or another tribe's person (-> state 34).

name: wildman idle tick
role: Wildman-only (type 1) periodic idle check, reached from state 1's own per-type hand-off: tries a tree/plant search (0x4D48E0) first, falls back to the shore search (0x4D4A00) on failure.

name: carrying out an order (order_execute)
role: The ordinary "run my current command group" state; the per-type default-on-expiry for braves through shamans (table 0x5A7064). A fight or pre-fight (states 25/29) pauses this without ever releasing the order - the SAME original order resumes exactly where it left off the moment the person drops out of the fight. See "Command groups".

name: idle/fidget cycle
role: A generic idle/fidget cycle: sub-state (`+0x2D`) alternates 1<->2 with an RNG 4-11 turn timer at `+0xAA`. Traced and ruled out as a "defends by preaching" mechanism. `0x434610`'s own row calls out a person finishing entering a building as "person state 0xA/0xE" - possibly the same state reused for "now idling inside", not reconciled with this reading.

name: idle at the shore
role: Wildman-only "drinking" stop, reached from state 6 on arrival at its shore destination; cycles an object/prop sub-state in [8..19] via `0x4D4040`, falls back to the per-type default on timer expiry.

name: tumbling / ground recovery
role: NOT the airborne ballistic flight itself (no velocity/height field +0x49/+0x4B/+0x4D/+0x41 is read anywhere in this function - that physics runs in the separate universal per-unit step, 0x4E6D1D/0x4E6D6D) - this is the GROUND recovery choreography that follows it, confirmed live (a tribe-1 brave hit by Blast enters this state the instant BLOWN, +0xC bit 0x80000, is set). Own sub-state (+0x2D) is a 0/1/2 arrival check (48-unit then 216-unit thresholds against a reference position, meaning unconfirmed) feeding an 8-way jump table (sub-states 3-10): picks a clear nearby cell via an 8-direction offset table (0x895ED9, default 0x895EF1) and moves there (0x4E9DD0); waits randomized timers (+0x70, 4-31 turns, LCG 0x89D178). **The "is this candidate spot OK" check, 0x4D5420, is now traced and confirmed NOT building-aware**: it walks the cell's own linked list (0x8A03E4) filtering strictly for class-1 (person) entries, checking only per-type terrain-climbability (WALK_ALT_DIFF2, movement-profile table 0x5A7B90+0x10, same field state 33 uses) and collision with another live person already claiming the same spot - a building (class 2) on that cell is simply invisible to this check. The sibling function in the initial arrival dispatch, 0x4D5120, is more involved and surfaces one new unconfirmed lead: a per-CELL linked-list HEADER flag (`[cell_list_head+0x1]` bit 0x2, not a per-object field) that, when set, triggers a re-place via 0x4044B0 - plausibly "this cell holds something solid" (a building footprint is the obvious guess, not confirmed). Whether a thrown person can actually land ON or INSIDE a building is therefore most likely decided earlier, by the physics/landing height step against the building's footprint (open-populous TODO.md's Physics item), not by this state's own spot-picking. **Correction: +0x78 is NOT a trailing-effect counter (an earlier pass of this row wrongly equated it with state 26's own +0xA4 counter) - the Reference already documents +0x78 as a person's plain CARRIED WOOD amount.** The two checks on it here (threshold <1) just pick the matching Idle/Walk vs. holding-wood/Walk-with-wood pose pair (see animation note below); separately, once the first wait timer expires with wood still carried, it spawns a class-5 type-0xB debris effect once per exactly 100 wood decremented from +0x78 (one standard wood load) until 0 - reads as dropping/spilling carried wood in a puff per load while settling, not a generic effect burst (the same +0x78-by-100 pattern, unexplained at the time, also appears in "Preacher conversion"'s sub-state 4 - likely the same wood-drop mechanic there too). NOT ACTUALLY OBSERVED LIVE: the one live trial never logged +0x78/wood, so whether this branch (holding-wood pose, wood-drop puffs) fired for that specific brave is unknown - needs a wood-carrying brave specifically. Every 32 turns while grounded, two more LCG rolls can kick it back into sub-state 6 (~13/32) or 10 (~3/64), both also setting flags+0xC bit 0x40000000 (the same bit cheat.md's live drowning trace found on entering the water-sink sequence - looks like a general pose-variant bit here, not confirmed water-exclusive) - this randomness is why live substates wander non-monotonically (4→5→10→5→6→7…) instead of counting through a fixed sequence. Sub-state 7 ("getting up") rerolls a fresh facing/timer before looping back. Exit: two epilogues return the per-type default state via the same table 0x5A7064 state 1 (0x4D3386) uses, one a fixed state 0x27 (39, shaman debug-mode override, same pattern as 0x518560). Ghidra's function range for 0x4D73E0 (claimed end 0x4D80B9) is wrong - 0x4D7FD0 inside that range is actually the death/spirit-rise record push (state 3's own mechanism), a separate function. **Animations resolved this session, directly from the exe's static data (0x5A6D50/0x5A6858, "Fight"'s own `[action×9+type]` table at 0x4D3FF0, cross-checked against 7 already-known action values, all matching)**: no dedicated "down" sprite - calls 0x4D3FF0 with actions 1/5 (already-documented Walk/Walk-with-wood, picked by the +0x78 wood check above) while moving to the picked spot, and 0/4 while settling, resolving to plain Idle (action 0, VSTART 6/53) and VSTART 10 ("standing still, holding wood", brave-specific, action 4, likewise wood-gated) - both already named in open-populous animations.md. So this whole recovery window most likely looks like an ordinary idle/standing (or holding-wood, if carrying any) person that just isn't taking orders, plus a few dropped-wood puffs if it had wood - not a visibly prolonged "struggling on the ground" animation. This static table-reading is independently cross-checked against 7 already-known action values (all matched exactly) but NOT itself confirmed against this specific live trial. See open-populous pop3-rev-analysis.md "Tumbling and ground recovery" / "A blasted person fighting back".

name: the conversion roll
role: The preacher-conversion CANDIDATE's own state while a roll is in progress (the striker is resolved via the candidate's own `+0x89`). Full preconditions, the success path (kill-and-replace, not a tribe-byte flip), and the roll-failure sub-state (0-6) "being preached to" choreography are all traced and live-confirmed - see "Preacher conversion" in pop3-rev-analysis.md. Explicitly excluded from the firewarrior/angel ranged-attack scan (0x51D0B0) and the Angel of Death's hunting AI (0x4DB980), but NOT excluded from the generic melee attacker-eligibility path (0x51C4C0) - confirmed live, a candidate can be pulled straight into pre-fight (29) or death (3) by an ordinary attacker.

name: lifted / orbiting (Whirlwind only)
role: Generic-looking "held by a reference thing, counting a sub-state up to 19" state; an exhaustive exe-wide search for every literal write of this state found only Whirlwind (0x50F490) ever sets it. NOT linked to preacher conversion despite an earlier draft's guess (corrected this investigation).

name: fight
role: Melee ring participant; the per-turn body is the generic "am I still in this fight" check - resolves the person's own `+0x9D` controller reference, 0 if dropped (falls to the per-type default, usually state 10). See "Fight".

name: scorched by a blast
role: Purely cosmetic "airborne and trailing fire" marker, set by the simple-blast push code (0x50B740) alongside a trailing-effect counter; counts down `+0x70` then falls back to the per-type default. A separate mechanism from "on fire" (state 31) - deals no damage itself.

name: Swamp's one-tick "about to die"
role: Set only by process_swamp (0x511400) as an alternative to deleting the victim outright; unconditionally advances to state 3 (death) the next tick. Not preacher-conversion-related (an earlier draft confused it with "struck").

name: Angel of Death hunting AI
role: The only type-8 (angel) state, confirmed via the per-type default-fallback table (0x5A7064: only type 8 maps here). Hunts the nearest enemy, preferring a rival angel first; reuses the same attacker/candidate type-pairing eligibility rule as `0x51C4C0`. Explicitly skips any candidate currently in state 23. See "Spells" / Angel of death.

name: pre-fight
role: Melee approach/kick-before-fight; identical per-turn body to state 25 (same function decides whether to stay or fall back to the per-type default).

name: on fire (burning)
role: Ongoing fire damage over time (per-type rate table `0x5A7070`), distinct from the purely cosmetic state 26. Counts down a duration, falls back to the per-type default on expiry.

name: blocked (stuck on terrain its type can't cross; misnamed "actively preaching" by an earlier draft)
role: **Correction, separate session, trigger now fully confirmed (live-play cross-check: a unit visibly halts in an arms-up pose on steep terrain, then starts losing life after a while - matches exactly)**. Entry: the generic "take one movement step" helper (`0x4EA920`, used everywhere - ordinary walking, preach's approach, go_into_building) calls `0x4EA970` (an 8-slot-cached "is this step blocked" check, almost certainly the per-type `WALK_ALT_DIFF2` terrain-height-difference test - movement profile table `0x5A7B90+0x10`, "how much height change this type can climb") and, if blocked, sets `unit+0x13` bit 0x10 - `order_execute`'s own shared tail (`0x432590`) and a sibling helper (`0x432260`, called from `init_unit_class_1`) both read this exact flag and transition the unit straight into state 33 instead of continuing its order normally. This state's own per-turn handler (0x4D9650) does NOT reference a preacher, a candidate, or anything preach-specific anywhere - it is rhythm-gated (every 8 ticks, the same cadence as invisible/shield/bloodlust/hypnotised): a grace timer (`+0x70`) climbs by 7 per qualifying tick toward a ceiling (flat 32 under the debug/cheat flag, else `0x160`/`0x360` picked by an unidentified per-tribe byte at `tribe+0xC1F`) - once at the ceiling, instead of climbing further it deals 56 life damage every 8 ticks (skippable by a global cheat flag), matching "after a while they start losing life". Its own substate machine (0-3) tries up to 8 waypoints to escape (`0x4EA920` again - re-checking the SAME blocked-step logic per attempt, via the per-type `WALK_ALT_DIFF2`/movement-profile-flag-0x18 branch, or a packed passability/visibility bitmap at `0x96AA74` when that profile flag is clear), falling back to the per-type default (table `0x5A7064`) on several exits. The two real class-1 setters of this state (`0x4324A2`/`order_execute`'s own tail and `0x432CFF`/`0x432260`) are both this exact blocked-flag check, not generic order-dispatch machinery as first guessed, and not preach-specific either way (a third raw setter, `0x512A31`, is a false positive - it belongs to the LAVA FLOW class-7 effect's own init, effect type 34/state 33, a completely different state-number space that happens to share the number 33). 0x4D83B0 (the conversion roll) accepting striker state ∈ {10, 33} as a precondition therefore just means "the striker is either ordinarily carrying out its order, or has momentarily gotten stuck on terrain mid-approach" - not evidence that state 33 itself means "preaching".

name: noticing something
role: Set on BOTH units of a "notice" pairing (a scenery type-9 "head", an unidentified vehicle type, or a different-tribe person, 18.75% chance) found during state 6's walk to the shore; cross-linked via `+0x72` like state 5's own binding. Own per-turn handler untraced - what it actually leads to is open.

name: shaman debug-mode fallback
role: A fixed state substituted for a shaman's own per-type default (table 0x5A7064) only when a global debug/option flag (0x89D17C bit 2) is set, seen at several unrelated "fall back to default" sites (0x518560, 0x4D8E40, 0x43AEC0, 0x4D83B0's own tails). Own per-turn handler untraced - only ever seen as a target value, not read from.

name: unidentified Angel-of-Death-adjacent state
role: Set by 0x4DB980 on a DIFFERENT referenced unit (not the angel itself) under a condition resembling "Attacking a building"'s own sub-state fields (`+0xA8` sub-state 2, `+0x76` bit 0x10); not reconciled with that section, own per-turn handler untraced.

name: lightning-carbonized
role: Set only by process_lightning_bolt (0x511F70); a sub-state counter stands the victim rigid for ~18 ticks, then (at count 18) advances to state 3 (death). The "lightning-carbonized" animation family CONTEXT.md describes.
